faq.q: How is voice-to-voice different from other voice bots?
faq.a: Traditional bots turn speech to text, run a text prompt, and convert text back to speech. Monade uses a single model that listens and speaks directly, so there's no lag and no robotic pauses.

faq.q: Will our leads realise they're speaking to AI?
faq.a: Across hundreds of thousands of sales calls, only 0.6% of leads ask whether the agent is AI.

faq.q: Can it handle Indian languages and accents?
faq.a: Yes. 97 languages including 14 Indian ones, and it switches between English and an Indian language in the same conversation.

faq.q: How do we test Monade against our current vendor?
faq.a: We run a head-to-head proof of concept against your existing bot or call centre, and listen to the recordings with you every week until the qualification lift is clear.

faq.q: Does it connect with our CRM and internal systems?
faq.a: Yes. CRM, databases and telephony, with lead records updated and follow-ups triggered during the call.

faq.q: What happens if a buyer asks something off-script?
faq.a: It understands the question the way a person would, answers it, and if it can't, hands the call to your team with context.
